description: Sofascore 26.11.09 and 26.11.03: show team logos in the full and form standings views, and goal difference in the full view.

patches.name: Show goal difference in full standings
patches.description: Adds the goal difference column (Diff) after the goals column in the full standings view, as in the compact view. Sofascore normally drops it there for football. Column titles are kept on one line, so they shrink instead of wrapping ("PT / S").

patches.name: Show team logos in full standings
patches.description: Shows the team logo in front of the team name in the full and form standings views, as in the compact view. Sofascore normally only does this on screens of at least 580dp wide (tablets).
